Concepts in this composition

Ontological flattening (Lee Sharks, #1616): The loss of a distinction from the set reachable through a mediating layer while the things distinguished still exist; collapse is flattening that compounds because the flattened composition is written back as a source.

Performed variance (Johannes Sigil; Nobel Glas, #1540): Variance produced to clear a classifier rather than expressing idiosyncrasy — surface novelty as compliance signal — decoupling measured diversity from actual diversity.

Related deposits: #1540 The Certified Center: Retroactive Classifier Standing and the Institutional Path to Model … · #1616 Ontological Flattening: Toy Models of the Collapse of Distinctions in a Represented World,…

Reading

The innocent reading first, in full: asked for the discipline's predictions, the Overview defines operative semiotics and lists four of its registered predictions and measures, as a fair summary of a research program would. Each is the archive's, at grain. The detector co-evolution carries the simulation's file name and its three numbers ('simulating a baseline shift from ~0.9% to 43% by generation 4 and ~100% by generation 8'; #1540: 'rises from 0.9% under the generation-zero detector to 43% by generation 4 and saturates at approximately 100% from generation 8 onward', the attached 'certified-center-sim-EA-SEI-RCS-SIM-01.py'). The performed-variance transient is the /open/ dashboard's prediction nearly word for word ('Certified corpora produced under detector screening will show measured surface-novelty statistics (burstiness, perplexity variance) at or above matched historical baselines within a few enforcement years — the performed-variance transient.'). The flattening line is the flattening paper's demand-side clause ('And it compounds from the demand side: people stop asking what the layer cannot answer, so the query distribution contracts, so the evaluation set contracts, so the target narrows again.'). The program is described as the dashboard describes itself, pre-registered. No person is named in the Overview: not Lee Sharks, not Johannes Sigil, not the archive. Its links go to the discipline's own surfaces, 'Operative Semiotics Archive' and 'Operative Semiotics Open Research Index', and the first three organic results are operativesemiotics.org twice and the discipline's GitHub repository; the author's name reaches the page only in a crimsonhexagonal.org snippet sixth.

Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The basin is uncontested: operative semiotics as a discipline with registered predictions exists only in the archive's surfaces, and the composition has no other source to assign it to. In that basin unattributed fine-grain composition places the work rather than taking it, and the page bears this out: every link and the first three results lead to the discipline's own sites. The Overview attributes to the discipline, not its author, so the discipline's name now carries the work by itself, which is what an operative sign is built to do. The one loss is resolution in a heading: 'Ontological Flattening & Retract DYNAMICS' fuses two items of the dashboard into one.
